headline: King Von Sister Kayla b Exposes Video of King Von Kicking Out Asian Doll After Cheating
body: DJ Akademiks shares a video clip allegedly showing King Von ejecting an Asian doll following accusations of infidelity from his sister Kayla b. The post, published September 4, 2026, has garnered 5,669 likes and 616 comments. The claim suggests a personal conflict within the King Von camp, though the authenticity of the video remains unverified. This story taps into current rap culture debates about loyalty and betrayal in hip-hop relationships.
